washer-solid-x-axis.alt: Left: the region between y = √x (top) and y = 1 (bottom) from x = 1 to 4, shaded, with a thin vertical rectangle and arrows from the x-axis to the curve (outer radius R) and to the line (inner radius r). Right: the solid made by revolving the region about the x-axis, a flared horn with a round hole of radius 1 along the axis, with one washer highlighted in blue: R = √x reaches the curve and r = 1 reaches the line, both from the axis. Below: V = the integral from 1 to 4 of π[(√x)² − 1²] dx = 9π/2.
